_comment: Single source of geometry, read by both oracle.py and author_part.py so they cannot disagree. Give every value an evidence_state; see docs/cad_agent_briefing.md for what the states mean and which may be chosen by the designer.

material._comment: Aluminium 6061-T6. The FEA reads E, nu and yield from here so it cannot disagree with the density the CAD oracle uses -- it did: the first solve used steel's 200 GPa against this 2700 kg/m3 aluminium, which left stress right (traction-loaded stress is independent of E) and displacement low by 2.9x.
material.name: aluminium 6061-T6
